budget_rule: Baseline-only sizing jobs are admitted sequentially only when each840+60-second reservation fits the actual remaining ledger. These are not selected arms of a paired decision block. All three sizing jobs are required to derive a rate; partial calibration remains explicit. No lowering of startup allowance.
capacity_basis: Four admitted groups,320 tokens/chunk,10485760 bytes/chunk. Conservatively count ceil(6144/320) chunks in every group, including unreachable recurrent history. This upper bound fits the smallest1GiB candidate.
downstream: After sizing, derive and freeze rates/horizon only if all three seeds complete with valid measurements. Then assess each native ARC working-set calibration job against remaining budget. No paired all-arm or decision block starts unless its complete quote fits.
